note: Cut diagonally through the existing North Beach blocks (and Washington Square) as Montgomery Avenue, 1873-74 (not on the 1869 maps, in place by 1873 per the Huntington's map record; built 1873-1875 per Washington Square histories); renamed Columbus Avenue in 1909. Buildings in its path were condemned and demolished.
Broadway Tunnel under Russian Hill (Robert C. Levy Tunnel): opened to traffic 1952-12-21; before that Broadway stopped at the hill on both sides.
Broadway Tunnel (centreline segment without a street type): opened 1952-12-21.
Stockton Street Tunnel (Bush - Sacramento): inaugurated 1914-12-29 with the Muni F Stockton cars; Stockton St climbed over the hill before.

Great Highway along Ocean Beach opened 1929-06-09 (O'Shaughnessy's Esplanade 1928); no buildings stand along most of it, so the building rule left long stretches at the 1950 default. rule = set: the researched year replaces the estimate (also for the few stretches dated earlier by old beach buildings).
